description: A bar that switches between sections of the same level, one visible at a time.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Tab splits the content of a screen into sections of the same level. One section is visible at a time, and the person can go to any of them, in any order, without leaving the screen.
whenToUseItems: A screen with 2 to 8 parallel sections, each with its own content.
Sections the person visits in any order.
whenNotToUseItems: Only one section: show the content directly, without tabs.
To filter one list (All, Pending, Paid): use the Filter Bar, [Chips](docs:components-chips--docs).
Steps in sequence: use [Steps](docs:components-steps--docs). Do not combine Tab and Steps on the same screen.
More than 8 sections: use a menu or page navigation.
A section that is unavailable to the person: do not show the tab. There is no disabled tab.
variantRows: Default|Tabs sized to their labels, aligned to the left.|default
With badge|A counter after the label.|withBadge
With scroll|More tabs than the width holds; the bar scrolls.|withScroll
Mobile|Up to three tabs share the width.|mobile
Long labels|Labels on one line; the bar scrolls instead of wrapping.|longLabels

formatting.title: Formatting
formatting.layoutText: The bar follows the layout rule on its own.
layoutRows: Desktop (576px and above)|Any number|Each tab as wide as its label, aligned to the left. If they do not fit, the bar scrolls sideways.
Mobile (below 576px)|Up to 3, all labels fit|The tabs share the width equally.
Mobile (below 576px)|4 or more, or a label that does not fit|Each tab as wide as its label; the bar scrolls with 32px on each side.

rows: 3|Selection line|Selected tab only|One line for the bar; slides under the selected tab and spans its width.

content.title: Content
content.text: Each tab names one section of the screen.
writingItems: Name the section with one or two words, in sentence case.
Keep the labels of a bar parallel: all nouns, about the same length.
Use the counter for an amount the person acts on, like items pending.
content.useDo: Use tabs for sections with their own content.
content.useDont: Do not use tabs to filter one list; use the Filter Bar ([Chips](docs:components-chips--docs)).

behaviors.title: Behaviors
behaviors.text: Tab has four states. Keyboard focus looks exactly like hover, without a focus ring. On a change, the selection line slides to the new tab and the colors ease; a hidden tab or one near an edge is scrolled gently toward the center. With reduced motion the change and the scroll are instant.

chips.title: Chips
chips.text: Use Chips as the Filter Bar to filter one list.

steps.title: Steps
steps.text: Use Steps for steps in sequence.

badge.title: Badge
badge.text: The counter of a tab is a small count Badge.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
rows: Tab|Moves the focus into the bar, to the selected tab, and then out of it.
Arrow right|Moves to the next tab and selects it; from the last, goes to the first.
Arrow left|Moves to the previous tab and selects it; from the first, goes to the last.
Home / End|Moves to the first or the last tab and selects it.

screenReaders.title: Screen readers
rows: Bar|Announced as a tab list, with the name given in `aria-label`.
Tab|Announced as a tab, with its position and whether it is selected.
Counter|Read as part of the tab name ("Payments 3").

development.title: Development considerations
items: **Name the bar.** Pass `aria-label` when no visible heading names the sections.
**Connect the panel.** Render the panel with `role="tabpanel"` and `aria-labelledby` set to the tab id (`<id>-tab-<index>`); pass `panelId` to set `aria-controls`.
**Focus has no ring.** Keyboard focus looks like hover, by design decision; keep the bar on a white background so the change of color stays visible.
